units.source_text: 浮舟的母亲因常陆守邸内正为祈祷女儿安产而举办法事，

en.t: Ukifune's mother stayed away because prayers were being held at the Hitachi governor's residence for her daughter's safe delivery,

units.source_text: 而自己又因到过丧家，身蒙不祥之气，

en.t: and because she herself had visited a house of mourning and was tainted by its inauspicious impurity,

units.source_text: 所以返京后不赴常陆守邸内，暂时旅居在三条地方那所简陋的屋子里。

en.t: so after returning to the capital she did not go to the Hitachi governor's residence, but lodged for a time in that humble house near Sanjo.

units.source_text: 她的哀思也无法自慰。

en.t: Her grief could not be comforted.

units.source_text: 一方面又挂念邸内的女儿是否安产。

en.t: At the same time she worried whether the daughter at the residence had given birth safely.

units.source_text: 后来闻知这女儿平安地分娩了。

en.t: Later she heard that this daughter had delivered her child safely.

units.source_text: 但她因为身蒙不祥，未便去看产妇。

en.t: But because she was touched by impurity, it was not proper for her to visit the new mother.

units.source_text: 对其他子女也无法照顾，只是茫然地度日。

en.t: She could not look after her other children either, and passed the days in a daze.

units.source_text: 正在此时，薰大将悄悄地派人送信来了。

en.t: Just then, Captain Kaoru quietly sent someone with a letter.

units.source_text: 母夫人虽然神志昏迷，也觉得十分可喜，又十分可悲。

en.t: Though the mother was almost senseless with grief, she felt both deeply glad and deeply sorrowful.

units.source_text: 薰大将的信中写道：“此次不幸而遭逢意外之变，

en.t: Captain Kaoru's letter said, "In this unhappy and unexpected calamity,

units.source_text: 鄙人首先应向夫人致吊。

en.t: I should first have offered my condolences to you, madam.

units.source_text: 然而心绪缭乱，泪眼昏花。

en.t: Yet my heart was in turmoil, and my eyes were dim with tears.

units.source_text: 推想夫人爱子情深，亦必悲伤至极。

en.t: Knowing how deeply you loved your child, I imagine your sorrow must be extreme.

units.source_text: 因此欲待心绪稍宁，再行奉候。

en.t: For that reason I meant to wait until my feelings had calmed a little before calling on you.

units.source_text: 不觉岁月匆匆，已过多时。

en.t: Before I knew it, time hurried by, and much of it had already passed.

units.source_text: 痛感世事无常，更觉愁恨难消。

en.t: I feel the impermanence of the world all the more keenly, and my sorrow and regret will not fade.

units.source_text: 但鄙人倘得侥幸存命于世，务请视我为令嫒之遗念，

en.t: But if I should be fortunate enough to remain alive in this world, please regard me as a remembrance of your daughter,

units.source_text: 随时枉顾为幸。”

en.t: and honor me by visiting whenever you wish."

units.source_text: 此信写得非常诚恳，送信的使者就是那个大藏大夫仲信。

en.t: The letter was written with great sincerity, and the messenger who brought it was that Nakano Nobunobu, the senior assistant in the Treasury.

units.source_text: 薰大将又嘱仲信口头传言：“鄙人行事迟缓，

en.t: Captain Kaoru also instructed Nakanobu to deliver this message orally: "Because I acted so slowly,

units.source_text: 以致年关已过而尚未迎接令嫒入京，

en.t: the year has already turned and I still have not brought your daughter to the capital,

units.source_text: 夫人或将疑我恩情消减乎？

en.t: so perhaps you may suspect that my affection has cooled.

units.source_text: 然而既往不咎，自今以后，无论何事，必当尽力效劳。

en.t: Yet let the past be past; from now on, whatever the matter may be, I will do all I can to serve you.

units.source_text: 夫人亦请暗记在心。

en.t: Please keep this quietly in mind.

units.source_text: 令郎等如欲出仕朝廷，鄙人定当尽力拔擢。”

en.t: If your sons wish to enter court service, I will certainly do my utmost to advance them."

units.source_text: 夫人认为子女之丧并无十分需要忌避的不洁，

en.t: The lady thought that the mourning for a child did not carry such impurity as to require strict avoidance,

units.source_text: 故无甚妨碍，坚请使者入内坐憩。

en.t: so there was little obstacle, and she strongly urged the messenger to come inside and rest.

units.source_text: 自己挥泪作复，复书中说：“身逢逆事而能苟延残喘，

en.t: Wiping away her tears, she wrote a reply, saying, "That I can still draw breath after meeting such misfortune,

units.source_text: 忧伤度日，正乃仰承宠锡嘉言之故。

en.t: and pass my days in sorrow, is only because I have received your gracious and comforting words.

units.source_text: 多年以来，每见小女愁苦之状，常痛感此乃为母亲者出身微贱之罪。

en.t: For many years, whenever I saw my little daughter's suffering, I keenly felt that it was the fault of her mother's low birth.

units.source_text: 近蒙惠许迎接入京，正庆从此可得托庇长享幸福。

en.t: Recently, when you graciously agreed to bring her to the capital, I rejoiced that from then on she might rely on your protection and enjoy lasting happiness.

units.source_text: 岂知忽遭无可挽回之灾厄，令人闻‘宇治’之名，

en.t: Who could have known that she would suddenly meet an irreversible disaster, so that even hearing the name 'Uji'

units.source_text: 亦觉凶恶可嫌，悲伤无极。

en.t: now seems ominous and hateful, and my grief is without end.

units.source_text: 今蒙赐书存问，殷勤抚慰，欣喜之余，自觉寿命可延。

en.t: Now that you have sent a letter to inquire after me and comfort me so warmly, my joy makes me feel my life may be prolonged.

units.source_text: 倘得暂时生存于世，自当仰仗鼎力之助。

en.t: If I am able to live on in this world even for a little while, I shall surely depend on your powerful assistance.

units.source_text: 惟目前泪眼昏花，未能恭敬作复为歉。”

en.t: Only, at present my eyes are blurred with tears, and I apologize for being unable to make a properly respectful reply."

units.source_text: 送使者的礼品，若照普通规例，此时不甚相宜。

en.t: As for a gift to the messenger, according to ordinary custom it was not very appropriate at such a time.

units.source_text: 不送则又觉招待不周。

en.t: Yet if she sent nothing, it would seem discourteous.

units.source_text: 便把本欲奉呈薰大将的斑纹犀角带一条，

en.t: So she took a mottled rhinoceros-horn belt that she had intended to present to Captain Kaoru,

units.source_text: 以及精美佩刀一把装入袋中，载在使者车上，

en.t: together with a fine sword, placed them in a bag, and loaded them onto the messenger's carriage,

units.source_text: 对仲信说：“此物乃死者遗念。”

en.t: saying to Nakanobu, "These are mementos of the dead."

units.source_text: 即以奉赠。

en.t: Thus she presented them as gifts.

units.source_text: 使者返邸，薰大将看了这赠品，说道：“其实大可不必。”

en.t: When the messenger returned to the residence, Captain Kaoru saw the gifts and said, "There was really no need for this."

units.source_text: 使者报道：“常陆守夫人亲自接见，啼啼哭哭地说了许多话。

en.t: The messenger reported, "The Hitachi governor's wife received me in person and said many things while weeping.

units.source_text: 她说：‘连无知小儿亦蒙体恤关怀，实令人诚惶诚恐。

en.t: She said, 'Even the little children who know nothing have received your considerate concern, and I am truly humbled and afraid.

units.source_text: 况我等乃身份低微之人，反觉羞惭无地。

en.t: As for us, people of such low station, we feel all the more ashamed and have nowhere to hide.

units.source_text: 我当勿使外人知道何种关系，将所有不肖之子遣赴尊邸，

en.t: I shall keep outsiders from knowing what relationship is involved, and send all my unworthy sons to your residence,

units.source_text: 令其服役。’”

en.t: so that they may serve there.'"

units.source_text: 薰大将想道：“这些固然不是关系密切之人。

en.t: Captain Kaoru thought, "These people are certainly not close relations.

units.source_text: 然而天皇的后宫中，也并非没有地方官身份的女儿。

en.t: Yet in the emperor's inner palace, it is not as if there are no daughters of provincial officials.

units.source_text: 如果由于有宿世因缘而蒙皇上宠爱，也不至于受世人讥评吧。

en.t: If one receives the emperor's favor because of bonds from a former life, surely that is not enough to draw people's scorn.

units.source_text: 至于普通臣下，娶贫贱人家的女儿或嫁过人的妇人为妻，也是常有之事。

en.t: As for ordinary courtiers, it is common enough to marry the daughter of a poor and lowly household, or a woman who has been married before.

units.source_text: 外人纷纷传说我爱上了一个地方守吏的女儿，

en.t: People outside are all saying that I fell in love with the daughter of a provincial official,

units.source_text: 但我最初就不打算娶她为正妻，所以不能指为我行为上的污点。

en.t: but from the beginning I never meant to take her as my principal wife, so this cannot be called a stain on my conduct.

units.source_text: 况且那母亲丧失了一个女儿，不胜悲伤。

en.t: Besides, that mother has lost a daughter and is overwhelmed with grief.

units.source_text: 故我必须看这女儿面上而照顾她的家人，

en.t: Therefore, for the daughter's sake, I must look after her family,

units.source_text: 以慰这母亲之心。”

en.t: and so comfort this mother's heart."
